nodes.name: Air etching oxidation
nodes.procedure: The FeNi3 nanoparticles were firstly oxidized at 450 °C in air for 2 h to obtain the FeNi3 oxide (FeNi3–O) with a FeNi3 core and a NiO/Fe2O3 shell via Kirkendall effect.

nodes.name: Nitridation of hollow oxide
nodes.procedure: Subsequently, the FeNi3N products with hollow interiors (FeNi3N-h) were finally obtained by nitridation of the FeNi3–O nanoparticles at 450 °C in an NH3 atmosphere.
nodes.source_text: Subsequently, the FeNi3N products with hollow interiors (FeNi3N-h) were finally obtained by nitridation of the FeNi3–O nanoparticles at 450 °C in an NH3 atmosphere.

nodes.name: Direct nitridation
nodes.procedure: For comparison, a solid FeNi3N product (FeNi3N·s) was also fabricated without the air-etching step by direct nitridation of the starting FeNi3 nanoparticles.

stability.unit: 1000 CV cycles + 30 h chronoamperometry at 210 mV

nodes.source_text: The catalysts were drop-cast onto an inert glassy carbon electrode for catalytic performance evaluation in a standard three-electrode system in 1 M KOH solution... FeNi₃N·h displays the best electrocatalytic activity for the OER... overpotential of 210 mV... Tafel slope of 43.6 mV dec⁻¹... Cdl of FeNi₃N·h is 5.09 mF cm⁻², larger ECSA of 8.91 cm²... specific activity is 0.94 mA cm⁻² at 1.5 V... Rct of FeNi₃N-h is 30.0 Ω... long-term stability... 1000 CV cycles and chronoamperometry... 30 h (IR correction: 7 Ω; catalyst loading: 0.25 mg cm⁻²).

stability.unit: 1000 CV cycles + 30 h chronoamperometry at 185 mV

nodes.source_text: The HER catalytic performance of the as-prepared catalysts was also probed by linear sweep voltammetry polarization... FeNi₃N·h catalyst needs an overpotential of 185 mV... Tafel slope of FeNi₃N-h is fitted to be 134.7 mV dec⁻¹... Rct value of FeNi₃N-h is calculated to be 150 Ω... long-term stability... 1000 cycles and chronopotentiometry test for 30 h (IR correction: 7 Ω; catalyst loading: 0.25 mg cm⁻²).

nodes.description: Overall water splitting (OWS) in two-electrode alkaline electrolyzer
nodes.source_text: full water splitting driven by FeNi₃N as both the anode and cathode catalyst... FeNi₃N-h||FeNi₃N-h system affording a current density of 10 mA cm⁻²... only requires 1.63 V... chronoamperometry test shows no obvious performance decay to offer a current density of 10 mA cm⁻² for 30 h... faradaic efficiency... close to 100% for both the HER and OER.

FeNi₃N·s exhibits a greatly improved catalytic performance for the OER that needs an overpotential of 280 mV to offer 10 mA cm⁻²... Cdl of FeNi₃N·s [2.47 mF cm⁻²]... specific activity is 0.09 mA cm⁻²... Rct of FeNi₃N·s (155.3 Ω).
to achieve the benchmark current density of 10 mA cm⁻², ... FeNi₃N·s (235 mV)... Tafel slope... FeNi₃N·s (150.8 mV dec⁻¹)... Rct value of FeNi₃N·s (245 Ω).

nodes.description: Overall water splitting (OWS) in two-electrode alkaline electrolyzer
nodes.source_text: FeNi₃N·s shows a rather large cell voltage of 1.76 V to achieve the same current density.

The FeNi₃ particles show moderate catalytic capability for the OER with an overpotential of 320 mV to drive the benchmark current of 10 mA cm⁻²... Cdl ... FeNi₃ (1.52 mF cm⁻²)... specific activity ... FeNi₃ [0.06 mA cm⁻²]... Rct ... FeNi₃ (197 Ω).

nodes.characterization_summary: FeNi3N-h shows hollow interior due to Kirkendall effect with brightness contrast. FeNi3N-s are solid particles. FeNi3 are quasi-spherical ~100 nm diameter. FeNi3-O shows hollow interior.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The oxygen-etched FeNi3 nanoparticles in air show a hollow interior due to the Kirkendall effect... The direct nitridation of FeNi3 nanoparticles results in the formation of solid FeNi3N particles (FeNi3N-s, Fig. 1b).

properties.description: Image showing spherical Ni nanoparticles with diameter around 100 nm
High-resolution scanning electron microscopy image showing dense packing of spherical nanoparticles

nodes.characterization_summary: FeNi3N-h particles are crystalline with lattice spacings of 0.18 nm and 0.21 nm corresponding to the (200) and (111) facets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The FeNi3N·h particles are crystalline with lattice spacings of 0.18 nm and 0.21 nm, corresponding to the (200) and (111) facets (Fig. 1f).

properties.label: (g)
properties.description: High-resolution TEM image showing crystalline nanoparticles with visible lattice fringes

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern of FeNi3N-h shows sharp diffraction spots indicating single crystal-like patterns due to large crystal size (~100 nm).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern shows sharp diffraction spots (Fig. 1g).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX spectrum of FeNi3N-h shows presence of Fe, Ni, N, and O elements with Fe/Ni content ratio close to 1/3. Elements are uniformly distributed through the hollow structured particles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) spectrum shows the presence of Fe, Ni, N, and O elements (Fig. 1h) and the content ratio of Fe/Ni is found to be close to 1/3 (Table S1†).

nodes.characterization_summary: FeNi3 shows FCC FeNi3 phase (PDF#38-0419) with minor Fe2O3. FeNi3-O shows NiO (PDF#47-1049) and Fe2O3 (PDF#39-1346). FeNi3N-h and FeNi3N-s show FeNi3N phase (PDF#50-1434) with significant peak shift and narrow sharp peaks indicating large crystal size.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The chemical conversion at different stages could be confirmed by X-ray diffraction (XRD) analyses.

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution Fe 2p shows Fe-N at 706.9 eV for FeNi3N-h/s, Fe2+ at 710.3 eV, Fe3+ at 712.5 eV. Ni 2p shows Ni-N at 852.4 eV, Ni2+ at 855.1/872.7 eV. N 1s shows M-N at 397.3 eV, N-H at 399.4 eV, N-oxide at 402.7 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A new peak at around 706.9 eV for Fe 2p3/2 is observed that can be ascribed to the Fe–N signal for FeNi3N·h and FeNi3N·s... the characteristic peak of the metal–N bond is observed at 852.4 eV in the Ni 2p3/2 band... N 1s spectrum... deconvoluted into three peaks at 397.3 eV, 399.4 eV, and 402.7 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: For OER, Raman bands at 480 cm⁻¹, 554 cm⁻¹ (NiOOH e_g and A1g), and 693 cm⁻¹ (FeOOH) appear and strengthen with potential from 1.25-1.65 V. For HER, weak NiOOH/FeOOH bands show minimal change.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To probe the surface structure change of FeNi3N·h during the OER and HER, in situ Raman technology was employed at different potentials.
